## Expected outcome

Terminal diagnostic presentation may use a deterministic typed/rendered order because presentation is not execution. If a live scheduling consumer remains, update this description from the then-current code before implementing; do not add a general comparator or restore a scan.

## Acceptance

No Debug/display-derived execution order, global unresolved producer discovery or dead ordering helper remains. Opposite type-mint orders preserve semantic answers, causal work and artifacts. Exact diagnostics, tests, docs, formatting and strict lint pass.
